qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the fuel filter coupling nut?
What thread size is used for the fuel filter adapter?
What is the torque value for tightening the fuel filter to holder bolt?
Which component has the highest torque specification in the fuel filter system?
qa_pairs.answer: The fuel filter to holder (2AZ) has the highest torque specification at 22 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What thread specification is used for the hollow bolt in the fuel line to filter housing?
What type designation applies to the fuel line to filter housing and injection pump components?
Which fuel filter component requires the lowest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The adapter requires the lowest torque at 9 Nm
